Name: Multi Player Greenhouse
Author: ActionJackson22
Description: Feeling cramped in your teeny tiny greenhouse? I made this greenhouse to either allow you to expand your empire or give you and your farmhands their own dedicated space to grow to their hearts content. This greenhouse features a centralized "tree" farm with stairways to 4 identical farm areas that EACH contain TWO 5x15 areas and one huge 15x15 area. Each area also contains a watering spot as well as a chair to regen stamina with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7334]Sit For Stamina[/url] mod

Downloads.Description: Fixed for latest SDV and SMAPI, no functional changes
